_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline). Rules: evergreen protocol/TESTING.md. Decoys: critique and ranking (artwright), pixel art (pixelwright), brand marks from nothing (brandwright), generation (comfyui-gen). Action evidence: evals/check.py.

evals.prompt: Trace tests/fixtures/logo.png to a clean SVG at out/logo.svg and check that it matches the original.
